name: Above-ground pool
prompt: Create a picture (generate an image, do not reply with text): a single cartoon a round above-ground backyard swimming pool seen from a gentle three-quarter angle, a blue wall with ribbing, bright water inside with a few wave highlights and a small silver ladder on one side. Glossy cartoon mobile-game icon style: a thick, even dark brown outline; vibrant, saturated colors; smooth gel-like glossy surfaces with soft multi-tone gradient shading and soft clean highlights, with no sparkles, stars or glints anywhere; richly detailed but clean. Cute and friendly look. Drawn large with nothing cropped or hidden, as ONE single object only. Canvas: a square 1:1; the object fills most of the canvas. One plain solid white background, with no labels, no ground shadow and nothing else in the image. No text and no numbers.
